passages.text: Amina runs a small delivery business in Lagos with six riders. Last year she lost two big clients because riders arrived late and nobody told the customers. She made three changes. First, every rider must confirm each pickup in the group chat within five minutes. Second, if a rider is delayed by more than fifteen minutes, the rider must call the customer directly and offer a new time. Third, every Friday Amina reads all the week's complaints aloud at the team meeting and the team agrees on one fix. After four months, late deliveries fell by half and one lost client returned. Amina says the system works because problems are reported early, the customer always hears bad news first from the rider, and the team fixes only one thing at a time.
